annotations.title: Find the listings on my website

description: List the property listing pages on a seller's own website (url: the site, or the page that lists their properties), so they can be added to Fabrica (Sepolia Testnet) one by one with add_land (listingUrl). The site is read from its sitemap or its links; nothing is created or changed. Returns the site, each listing's link (up to 200) and whether the list was cut short. Only for the person's own listings on their own website: add_land copies each listing's description and photos. Needs the person to be signed in.

url.description: The seller's website, or the page that lists their properties (e.g. 'example-land.com/properties')

name: find_listings_on_website
